stats.note: Example week: only three dailies are bundled.

weekly_threads.title: From pass-through to price war in three days
weekly_threads.narrative: Halcyon Cloud opened the week with a 40% cut that it could justify with lower costs. By Wednesday Cinderpeak Compute had matched it without any such justification, and a third provider was reviewing its list. **What changed is the motive**: the first cut protected margin, the second one bought share. The story to watch is which provider blinks on committed-use discounts.

weekly_threads.title: Northwind's capex raise goes from plan to order book to argument
weekly_threads.narrative: Monday's guidance was a number. Tuesday a supplier confirmed that orders moved forward, and a research note argued that packaging, not wafers, is the industry's binding constraint. Wednesday brought the first pushback, on payback period rather than on demand. The spend is no longer in doubt; its return is.

weekly_threads.title: Vellmark: the debate moves from whether to when
weekly_threads.narrative: A hold that dropped the tightening bias, two dissents for a cut, and a 14bp fall in the two-year yield the next day. Markets now price June; at least one committee member says that is too early.

insights.observation: All three threads this week turned on a second data point that changed the meaning of the first.
insights.idea: For each open story, write down what the confirming and the disconfirming second data point would be.
